from tickets import load_tickets, ROWS
from ranges import hours_between


def test_three_positions():
    data = list(load_tickets())
    assert hours_between(data, 2, 4) == [v for _, v in ROWS[1:4]]


def test_low_above_high():
    data = list(load_tickets())
    assert hours_between(data, 3, 2) == []
